curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk the passing sequence, the horn duty, the two-foot clearance, where passing is unsafe or barred, then the passed driver's duties and the misdemeanor for speeding up.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for clearance versus sight distance and passer versus passed duties.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a pass and asking whether it is allowed.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: State the general ban on passing on the right, the listed exceptions, and the three-lane center lane rule.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; a contrast card for the exceptions.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on when passing on the right is allowed.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover parking on the right, pulling out, places never to park, the hydrant and cross-street distances, shoulders, fires, interstates and disabled spaces.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast cards for the parking distances.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming a spot and asking whether parking is allowed.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach checking behind before backing, steering and looking over the right shoulder, and the slow backing speed.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per step; a contrast card pairing speed and look direction.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain why intersections are dangerous, the median rule, slowing even with right of way, uncontrolled right of way rules, stop signs, driveways and single-point interchanges.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast cards for the uncontrolled-intersection order and right of way limits.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing two cars at an intersection and asking who goes.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Compare roundabouts with traffic circles, explain direction, lanes and right of way in a circle, then entering and exiting a roundabout.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast cards for circle and roundabout yielding.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on who yields in circles and roundabouts.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach how far around to go in a single-lane roundabout, lane choice in multi-lane roundabouts, emergency vehicles, bicyclists and pedestrians.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each route and rule; a contrast card for single-lane versus multi-lane routes.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming a destination and asking the route or lane.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec09-m01..sec09-m07; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

domain_emphasis_check.domain: Passing, backing, parking, intersections and roundabouts

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
